notes.title: Recognize these outfits?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9153188/769a509c8d02c9504c59737c097406d542bbda6f.png[/img]

These outfits have mysteriously transitioned from the 2D Koala Kids universe to 3D! Can you unlock them all in [b]Koala Kids Golf[/b]?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1803220/Koala_Kids_Golf/

In [b]Koala Kids Golf[/b] the hunters (now golfers) still want that precious treasure! And what a devious plan they've come up with this time.... ːchestoftreasureː ːemeraldgemː

Koalas as golf balls! ːhappykoalaː

Collect treasure before your opponents. Watch out for traps and dangers or you'll lose your gems!
Compete with Friends or play Challenges to unlock Stars and Customizables.
There are also Platinum Star Achievements that will truly test your Golfing skills!

[i]Can [b]you [/b]become the very best aerodynamic Koala? [/i]

ʕ•ᴥ•ʔ ♡
